paragraphs: Swing Education sells a substitute staffing platform that school districts use to fill classroom absences. The platform works as a K-12 marketplace that matches each absence to a substitute. Roles covered include daily and long-term teachers, special education support, paraprofessionals, classified staff, and clerical work.

Districts can buy Swing as a full-service solution or as a supplement to an internal substitute pool. Swing integrates with absence management systems such as Frontline Absence Management, so districts sync absences rather than entering them twice. Administrators set budgets by funding source and get alerts before hitting a spending limit.

Substitutes are recruited locally, vetted, and measured on performance, with high performers given priority for job access. Swing states that it partners with hundreds of school districts and thousands of educators nationwide. Placements run from same-day subs to month-long long-term coverage, with staffing handled so that school admin teams can focus on students.
